packet.goal: Deliver a runnable real Editor local-draft authored paragraph trial powered solely by the accepted retained Core frame before/during/after editing, including provisional IME.
acceptanceCriteria: Discoverable real Editor /core-editing-trial route with one authored Thai/Latin paragraph and supported Sarabun style/fixed width; launch instructions and explicit unsaved local-draft behavior. Existing Creator simulated field remains semantically separate.

Only coreAdapter imports product package. Runtime dispatches intents; React paints Core outline/frame/caret/selection atomically at same revision. Hidden textarea transports keyboard/IME; no browser visible shaping/wrapping. Pending retains last exact Core frame.
Typing, backspace/delete, selection/caret navigation, structural Enter to two authored paragraphs and supported inversejoin preserve style/empty sides. Restrictions explicit; no Backend save path.

Active browser IME provisional updates paint Core frames; final commit exactly once; cancellation/stale events do not lose/reorder text. Real browser composition path tested, OS candidate-window testing scope disclosed.

Compare same-input new frame to ORIGINAL Creator baseline glyph positions/linebreaks. Observe actual view/focus/edit/blur transition frames and pending behavior. Never replace both paths to fake parity; report observation coverage rather than universal all-frame proof.

Record real event-to-visible-frame timings, ordered text correctness and browser errors, with method/conditions; no orchestration duration mislabeled or Gate2 claim. Focused session tests and full Editor npm run check pass; commit clean exact candidate and return files/proof/limits.
